intro_section.title: Explore Beyond Andaz Peninsula Papagayo
paragraphs: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo offers beaches, dining, wellness and activities within one of Costa Rica's most distinctive resort destinations. When you want to experience more of the country, Wild Papagayo connects your stay with private journeys into Guanacaste and northern Costa Rica.
Explore wildlife, rainforest, volcanoes, waterfalls, hot springs, adventure experiences and local culture without adjusting your day to a shared tour schedule.
Book Direct. Explore Privately. Work directly with a local Costa Rican operator specializing in private experiences from Papagayo.

faq.q: What are the best private tours from Andaz Peninsula Papagayo?
faq.a: The Hanging Bridges & Sloths Experience, Rio Celeste, Rincon de la Vieja and the Buena Vista Mega Combo are among our most popular picks for Andaz guests, depending on your travel style.

faq.q: Does Wild Papagayo pick up directly from Andaz?
faq.a: Yes. Every tour includes private pickup directly from Andaz Peninsula Papagayo, coordinated around your selected experience and departure time.

faq.q: Are the tours private or shared?
faq.a: Every tour is private for your group, with your own vehicle, guide and pace, not a shared bus with other travelers.

faq.q: What is the best wildlife tour from Andaz Papagayo?
faq.a: The Hanging Bridges & Sloths Experience and the Palo Verde River Boat Tour are our top wildlife-focused options, each with a different pace and terrain.

faq.q: What is the best tour if we only have one free day?
faq.a: It depends on what you most want to see: Hanging Bridges & Sloths for wildlife, Rincon de la Vieja for a volcano, Rio Celeste for iconic scenery, or Costa Rica Highlights to combine several in one day.

faq.q: Can families book private tours from Andaz?
faq.a: Yes. Many of our tours are family-friendly, and because every tour is private, pacing can be adapted to the ages traveling with you.
Yes. Because every tour is private, pickup time, pacing and add-ons can be tailored to your group. Tell us your dates and interests and we'll help build the day.

faq.q: How far are Rio Celeste and Rincon de la Vieja from Andaz?
faq.a: Rio Celeste is roughly 110 to 140 minutes by private transfer, and Rincon de la Vieja's Las Pailas sector is roughly 93 to 118 minutes, based on real driving distance from Andaz.
